# WALLPAPER_SYSTEM (1.3.x)

## Built-in art (original, generated by `scripts/art/GenArt.java`, fixed seeds → reproducible)
`assets/site/art/`: `wall-01-midnight-blue`, `wall-02-violet-atmosphere`, `wall-03-deep-space`,
`wall-04-blue-light-flow`, `wall-05-pure-dark`, `wall-06-aurora-horizon` (+ `-thumb` 384×216) and screensaver
layers `ss-dark-orbit`, `ss-nebula-drift`, `ss-minimal-stars`, `ss-abstract-waves`. ~0.8 MB total, JPEG.
Regenerate: `java scripts/art/GenArt.java app/src/main/assets/site/art`.
The old "Live scenery (time & weather)" stays available as an option (it is the 1.2.x background).

## Settings
`wallpaper` (`w01`…`w06`, `scenery`, or a user image id `u<ms>`), `wallFit` (fill / fit / crop), `wallDim`
(off / low / medium / high), `theme`, `motion`. Default for 1.3.0: `w01` Midnight Blue, Center crop, Low.

## User images (`ImageLibrary.java`)
- Picked with the official `ACTION_GET_CONTENT` picker. On this receiver Android's own Documents UI is a stub
  (`com.android.tv.frameworkpackagestubs`), so the request goes to the only real picker (the installed file
  manager's PickerActivity). No storage permission is requested.
- The file is copied (max 40 MB input, max 16000 px side, JPG/PNG/WebP by real content), EXIF orientation applied,
  downscaled to cover 1920×1080 (never upscaled, longest side ≤ 2400) and saved as JPEG 90 + thumbnail in the app's
  private `files/images/` → survives restarts and updates; the original file is never changed or deleted.
- Max 60 images; free-space check (30 MB); errors → a toast (`corrupt`, `format`, `large`, `space`, `full`,
  `unreadable`, `nopicker`) and nothing changes.
- Removing a picture (long-press in a gallery) deletes only the app's copy; a wallpaper/screensaver that used it
  falls back to the default. A missing or broken image always falls back to Midnight Blue.

## Gallery
Settings › Appearance › Wallpapers: focus = live preview behind the window (page hidden while previewing),
OK = apply and save, Back = return to the saved wallpaper unchanged.
